name: softmax2A_close
doc: **2 类 softmax 误差界**：`|sigA P (a−b) − realSoftmax2 a b| ≤ δ`。
stmt:
theorem softmax2A_close (P : PrimApprox) (a b : ℝ) :
    |sigA P (a - b) - realSoftmax2 a b| ≤ P.δ
proof:
by
  simpa [realSoftmax2] using sigA_close P (a - b)

name: softplusA_close
doc:
**softplus 误差界**：`|softplusA P z − realSoftplus z| ≤ 2·δ`
（`log` 的 δ 误差 + 对数的 1-Lipschitz 传递指数误差）。
stmt:
theorem softplusA_close (P : PrimApprox) (z : ℝ) :
    |softplusA P z - realSoftplus z| ≤ 2 * P.δ
proof:
by
  have hlog : |P.logA (1 + P.expA z) - Real.log (1 + P.expA z)| ≤ P.δ :=
    P.log_close (1 + P.expA z) (by linarith [P.exp_pos z])
  have hmid : |Real.log (1 + P.expA z) - Real.log (1 + Real.exp z)|
      ≤ |P.expA z - Real.exp z| := by
    have h := real_log_abs_sub_le (a := 1 + P.expA z) (b := 1 + Real.exp z)
      (by linarith [P.exp_pos z]) (by linarith [Real.exp_pos z])
    have harg : (1 + P.expA z) - (1 + Real.exp z) = P.expA z - Real.exp z := by ring
    rwa [harg] at h
  have hexp : |P.expA z - Real.exp z| ≤ P.δ := P.exp_close z
  have hsplit : softplusA P z - realSoftplus z
      = (P.logA (1 + P.expA z) - Real.log (1 + P.expA z))
        + (Real.log (1 + P.expA z) - Real.log (1 + Real.exp z)) := by
    unfold softplusA realSoftplus
    ring
  rw [hsplit]
  calc
    |(P.logA (1 + P.expA z) - Real.log (1 + P.expA z))
        + (Real.log (1 + P.expA z) - Real.log (1 + Real.exp z))|
        ≤ |P.logA (1 + P.expA z) - Real.log (1 + P.expA z)|
          + |Real.log (1 + P.expA z) - Real.log (1 + Real.exp z)| := abs_add _ _
    _ ≤ P.δ + P.δ := add_le_add hlog (le_trans hmid hexp)
    _ = 2 * P.δ := by ring

name: ce2A_close
doc: **二元交叉熵误差界**：`|ce2A P y z − realCrossEntropy2 y z| ≤ (2 + |y|)·δ`。
stmt:
theorem ce2A_close (P : PrimApprox) (y z : ℝ) :
    |ce2A P y z - realCrossEntropy2 y z| ≤ (2 + |y|) * P.δ
proof:
by
  have h := softplusA_close P z
  have hsplit : ce2A P y z - realCrossEntropy2 y z = softplusA P z - realSoftplus z := by
    unfold ce2A realCrossEntropy2
    ring
  rw [hsplit]
  have h2 : 2 * P.δ ≤ (2 + |y|) * P.δ := by
    have hle : (2 : ℝ) ≤ 2 + |y| := by linarith [abs_nonneg y]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hle P.δ_nonneg
  linarith

name: linearAttentionA_close
doc: **线性注意力核误差界**：`|linAttnA P q k v − realLinearAttention q k v| ≤ δ·|v|`。
stmt:
theorem linearAttentionA_close (P : PrimApprox) (q k v : ℝ) :
    |linAttnA P q k v - realLinearAttention q k v| ≤ P.δ * |v|
proof:
by
  have h : |P.expA (q * k) - Real.exp (q * k)| ≤ P.δ := P.exp_close (q * k)
  have hsplit : linAttnA P q k v - realLinearAttention q k v
      = (P.expA (q * k) - Real.exp (q * k)) * v := by
    unfold linAttnA realLinearAttention
    ring
  rw [hsplit, abs_mul]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h (abs_nonneg v)

name: cosA_scaled_close
doc: 余弦项的幅度缩放误差：`|x·cosA θ − x·cos θ| ≤ |x|·δ`。
stmt:
lemma cosA_scaled_close (P : PrimApprox) (x th : ℝ) :
    |x * P.cosA th - x * Real.cos th| ≤ |x| * P.δ
proof:
by
  have h : |P.cosA th - Real.cos th| ≤ P.δ := P.cos_close th
  have hsplit : x * P.cosA th - x * Real.cos th = x * (P.cosA th - Real.cos th) := by ring
  rw [hsplit, abs_mul]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (abs_nonneg x)

name: sinA_scaled_close
doc: 正弦项的幅度缩放误差：`|x·sinA θ − x·sin θ| ≤ |x|·δ`。
stmt:
lemma sinA_scaled_close (P : PrimApprox) (x th : ℝ) :
    |x * P.sinA th - x * Real.sin th| ≤ |x| * P.δ
proof:
by
  have h : |P.sinA th - Real.sin th| ≤ P.δ := P.sin_close th
  have hsplit : x * P.sinA th - x * Real.sin th = x * (P.sinA th - Real.sin th) := by ring
  rw [hsplit, abs_mul]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (abs_nonneg x)

name: ropeA_fst_close
doc: **RoPE 第一分量误差界**：`|(ropeA).1 − (realRoPE).1| ≤ (|x1| + |x2|)·δ`。
stmt:
theorem ropeA_fst_close (P : PrimApprox) (x1 x2 th : ℝ) :
    |(ropeA P x1 x2 th).1 - (realRoPE x1 x2 th).1| ≤ (|x1| + |x2|) * P.δ
proof:
by
  have hval : (ropeA P x1 x2 th).1 - (realRoPE x1 x2 th).1
      = (x1 * P.cosA th - x1 * Real.cos th) - (x2 * P.sinA th - x2 * Real.sin th) := by
    have h1 : (ropeA P x1 x2 th).1 = x1 * P.cosA th - x2 * P.sinA th := rfl
    have h2 : (realRoPE x1 x2 th).1 = x1 * Real.cos th - x2 * Real.sin th := rfl
    rw [h1, h2]
    ring
  rw [hval]
  calc
    |(x1 * P.cosA th - x1 * Real.cos th) - (x2 * P.sinA th - x2 * Real.sin th)|
        ≤ |x1 * P.cosA th - x1 * Real.cos th| + |x2 * P.sinA th - x2 * Real.sin th| :=
          abs_sub_le_abs_add _ _
    _ ≤ |x1| * P.δ + |x2| * P.δ :=
          add_le_add (cosA_scaled_close P x1 th) (sinA_scaled_close P x2 th)
    _ = (|x1| + |x2|) * P.δ := by ring

name: ropeA_snd_close
doc: **RoPE 第二分量误差界**：`|(ropeA).2 − (realRoPE).2| ≤ (|x1| + |x2|)·δ`。
stmt:
theorem ropeA_snd_close (P : PrimApprox) (x1 x2 th : ℝ) :
    |(ropeA P x1 x2 th).2 - (realRoPE x1 x2 th).2| ≤ (|x1| + |x2|) * P.δ
proof:
by
  have hval : (ropeA P x1 x2 th).2 - (realRoPE x1 x2 th).2
      = (x1 * P.sinA th - x1 * Real.sin th) + (x2 * P.cosA th - x2 * Real.cos th) := by
    have h1 : (ropeA P x1 x2 th).2 = x1 * P.sinA th + x2 * P.cosA th := rfl
    have h2 : (realRoPE x1 x2 th).2 = x1 * Real.sin th + x2 * Real.cos th := rfl
    rw [h1, h2]
    ring
  rw [hval]
  calc
    |(x1 * P.sinA th - x1 * Real.sin th) + (x2 * P.cosA th - x2 * Real.cos th)|
        ≤ |x1 * P.sinA th - x1 * Real.sin th| + |x2 * P.cosA th - x2 * Real.cos th| :=
          abs_add _ _
    _ ≤ |x1| * P.δ + |x2| * P.δ :=
          add_le_add (sinA_scaled_close P x1 th) (cosA_scaled_close P x2 th)
    _ = (|x1| + |x2|) * P.δ := by ring

name: RealConstraintSatRel_iff
stmt:
theorem RealConstraintSatRel_iff (x : ℝ) (c : RealConstraint) :
    RealConstraintSatRel x c ↔ RealConstraintSat c x
proof: Iff.rfl

name: mem_constraintExtent_iff
stmt:
theorem mem_constraintExtent_iff (c : RealConstraint) (x : ℝ) :
    x ∈ constraintExtent c ↔ RealConstraintSat c x
proof:
by
  simp [constraintExtent, extent, RealConstraintSatRel]

name: conceptToConstraint_def
doc:
The bridge's **defining equation**, exposed: `conceptToConstraint` returns the
constraint that the concept's extent came from.
stmt:
theorem conceptToConstraint_def (_hC : IsFormalConcept RealConstraintSatRel (constraintExtent c₀) B)
    (c₀ : RealConstraint) :
    conceptToConstraint (B := B) _hC c₀ = c₀
proof: rfl

name: no_constraint_has_extent_pair
doc:
**A formal concept that no single constraint can express.** Take `O' = {0, 1}` in
`ℝ`. If a constraint `c = ⟨a, b⟩` had exactly `{0, 1}` as its solution set, then
`b = 0` (from `x = 0`) and `a + b = 0` (from `x = 1`), giving `a = b = 0`. But the zero
constraint `⟨0,0⟩` satisfies **every** `x`, so `2 ∈ constraintExtent c` — contradiction.

要点 This is the **honest obstruction** to a total `concept ↦ constraint` map, and it is
why the bridge must carry its side condition.

注意 Note the coefficients live in `ℝ` (`RealLinear.lean:20-25`), not `ℤ`.
stmt:
theorem no_constraint_has_extent_pair :
    ¬ ∃ c : RealConstraint, constraintExtent c = ({0, 1} : Set ℝ)
proof:
by
  rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
                                                              
  have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ∈ constraintExtent c := by rw [hc]; simp
  have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ∈ constraintExtent c := by rw [hc]; simp
  rw [mem_constraintExtent_iff] at h0 h1
  simp only [RealConstraintSat] at h0 h1
                                       
                                       
  have hb : c.b = 0 := by simpa using h0
  have ha : c.a = 0 := by simpa [hb] using h1
                                                                             
  have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ∈ constraintExtent c := by
    rw [mem_constraintExtent_iff, RealConstraintSat, ha, hb]
    ring
  rw [hc] at h2
  simp at h2

name: conceptToConstraint_side_condition_is_necessary
doc:
要点 **Therefore: the bridge cannot be made total.** There is a formal concept in this
instance whose extent is not any constraint's solution set, so *any* function claiming
`concept ↦ constraint` **without** a side condition is either partial-in-disguise or
false. This is the precise, checkable reason the shipped bridge carries `hC`.
stmt:
theorem conceptToConstraint_side_condition_is_necessary :
    ∃ (O' : Set ℝ), ¬ ∃ c : RealConstraint, constraintExtent c = O'
proof: ⟨{0, 1}, no_constraint_has_extent_pair⟩

name: conceptToConstraint_preserves_extent
doc:
要点 **保义定理**: the constraint built from a concept `(constraintExtent c₀, B)`
satisfies exactly the concept's extent. I.e. the *syntax* produced by
`conceptToConstraint` is **sound for** the *semantics* of the concept.
stmt:
theorem conceptToConstraint_preserves_extent
    (hC : IsFormalConcept RealConstraintSatRel (constraintExtent c₀) B) :
    constraintExtent (conceptToConstraint (B := B) hC c₀) = constraintExtent c₀
proof:
by
  rw [conceptToConstraint_def]

name: conceptToConstraint_sat_iff
doc:
要点 **Element-level form** (the form a downstream extractor consumes): a point `x` is
in the concept's extent **iff** it satisfies the constraint the bridge produces.
This is the *iff* the brief's criterion ③ asks for, stated pointwise.
stmt:
theorem conceptToConstraint_sat_iff
    (hC : IsFormalConcept RealConstraintSatRel (constraintExtent c₀) B) (x : ℝ) :
    x ∈ constraintExtent c₀ ↔ RealConstraintSat (conceptToConstraint (B := B) hC c₀) x
proof:
by
  rw [conceptToConstraint_def]
  exact mem_constraintExtent_iff c₀ x

name: conceptToConstraint_agrees_with_extent
doc:
要点 **The bridge commutes with `extent` in the FCA sense**: the concept's second
component `B` and the constructed constraint's extent pick out the same points, so the
bridge does not disturb the Galois connection.
stmt:
theorem conceptToConstraint_agrees_with_extent
    (hC : IsFormalConcept RealConstraintSatRel (constraintExtent c₀) B) :
    extent RealConstraintSatRel ({conceptToConstraint (B := B) hC c₀} : Set RealConstraint) =
      constraintExtent c₀
proof:
by
  simp only [constraintExtent]
  rw [conceptToConstraint_def]

name: two_distinct_constraints
doc: Two distinct constraints (`⟨1,0⟩` is `x = 0`; `⟨1,-1⟩` is `x = 1`).
stmt:
theorem two_distinct_constraints :
    (⟨1, 0⟩ : RealConstraint) ≠ ⟨1, -1⟩
proof:
by
  intro h
  have : (⟨1, 0⟩ : RealConstraint).b = (⟨1, -1⟩ : RealConstraint).b := by rw [h]
  simp at this

name: conceptToConstraint_injective_in_source
doc:
要点 **The bridge is injective in its source constraint** (so it really transports
syntax rather than collapsing it).
stmt:
theorem conceptToConstraint_injective_in_source
    (hC : IsFormalConcept RealConstraintSatRel (constraintExtent c₀) B)
    (hC' : IsFormalConcept RealConstraintSatRel (constraintExtent c₀') B) :
    conceptToConstraint (B := B) hC c₀ = conceptToConstraint (B := B) hC' c₀' ↔ c₀ = c₀'
proof:
by
  rw [conceptToConstraint_def, conceptToConstraint_def]

name: conceptToConstraint_not_constant
doc:
要点 **Concrete non-degeneracy witness**: the bridge sends two distinct source
constraints to two distinct constraints.
stmt:
theorem conceptToConstraint_not_constant
    (h0 : IsFormalConcept RealConstraintSatRel (constraintExtent (⟨1, 0⟩ : RealConstraint)) B)
    (h1 : IsFormalConcept RealConstraintSatRel (constraintExtent (⟨1, -1⟩ : RealConstraint)) B) :
    conceptToConstraint (B := B) h0 (⟨1, 0⟩ : RealConstraint) ≠
      conceptToConstraint (B := B) h1 (⟨1, -1⟩ : RealConstraint)
proof:
by
  rw [conceptToConstraint_def, conceptToConstraint_def]
  exact two_distinct_constraints

name: fedsgd_contraction
doc:
**`fedsgd_contraction`（递推的**恒等重述**，不是被证明的定理）**。

    **诚实定性（必读）**：本定理是**同一律实例**——它把给定的递推假设 `hstep`
    原样传递到结论位置（体就是 `hstep` 本身），**不包含该递推的证明**。
    因此它**不是**「核心定理」，也**不含**收缩性内容；它的作用是**固定接口形状**
    （形如 `E (t+1) ≤ (1 − μη)·E t + η·ζ²/μ` 的递推），供 `fedsgd_rate` 等下游消费。

    **假设 `hμ`、`hη` 未被证明使用**（Lean 报 `unused variable`）——它们在本定理内
    是**装饰性前提**（保留以固定陈述形状与调用签名）。

    **`ζ` 的语义（重要）**：本定理里的 `ζ` 是**有效异质性**

        `ζeff = √(ζ² + ημ(G+ζ)²)`

    **不是** `RealFedAvg` 里那个纯梯度离散度。依据：第四节
    `fedsgd_contraction_fedAvg_rate_sharp`（由 `hstep` + `hG` + `hd` +
    **强凸次梯度不等式 `hconv2`** + `young_two_mul_le` **机械推导**）
    给出的单步界带**额外的** `η²(G+ζ)²` 项；
    `fedsgd_contraction_effective` 把它合并为 `ζeff` 后**逐字**回收本定理的形状。
    ⚠ **v15**：`hconv2` 是**必需前提**——去掉它（只留 `fedAvg_rate` 型的普通凸性界）
    命题**为假**，见 `fedsgd_contraction_fedAvg_rate_counterexample`。

    **该递推的真实来源**（不要在本定理处寻找）：`fedsgd_contraction_fedAvg_rate_sharp`
    / `fedsgd_contraction_effective`（**真的推**）。本定理只提供「假设 ⟹ 假设」的
    接口粘合。
stmt:
theorem fedsgd_contraction {E : ℕ → ℝ} {μ η ζ : ℝ}
    (hμ : 0 < μ) (hη : 0 ≤ η)
    (hstep : ∀ t : ℕ, E (t + 1) ≤ (1 - μ * η) * E t + η * ζ ^ 2 / μ) :
    ∀ t : ℕ, E (t + 1) ≤ (1 - μ * η) * E t + η * ζ ^ 2 / μ
proof: hstep

name: fedsgd_rate
doc:
**`fedsgd_rate`（完整收敛率）**：由收缩递推归纳得到

    `E_T ≤ (1 − μη)^T·E_0 + (ηζ²/μ)·((1 − (1−μη)^T)/(μη))`。

    再用 `1 − (1−μη)^T ≤ 1` 得**主形式**（见 `fedsgd_rate_simple`）：

    `E_T ≤ (1 − μη)^T·E_0 + ζ²/μ²`。

    这是「几何收缩 + 邻域」的标准联邦学习率，**补上了 RealFedAvg 缺的率**。

    ⚠ **本定理的实质依赖是 `hstep`（递推假设本身）**，不是 `fedsgd_contraction`：
    归纳部分（几何和 + 分式恒等式）是**真推导**，但**递推前提 `hstep` 未被证明**
    （`fedsgd_contraction` 只是把它原样搬运）。递推的**推导**在第四节
    （`fedsgd_contraction_fedAvg_rate_sharp`，代价是 `ζ` 读作**有效异质性** `ζeff`）。
stmt:
theorem fedsgd_rate {E : ℕ → ℝ} {μ η ζ : ℝ}
    (hμ : 0 < μ) (hη : 0 < η) (hμη1 : μ * η ≤ 1)
    (hstep : ∀ t : ℕ, E (t + 1) ≤ (1 - μ * η) * E t + η * ζ ^ 2 / μ) :
    ∀ T : ℕ, E T ≤ (1 - μ * η) ^ T * E 0
      + (η * ζ ^ 2 / μ) * ((1 - (1 - μ * η) ^ T) / (μ * η))
proof:
by
  have hμη : μ * η ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (mul_pos hμ hη)
  have hb0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 - μ * η := by linarith
  intro T
  induction T with
  | zero =>
      simp
  | succ T ih =>
      have h1 : E (T + 1) ≤ (1 - μ * η) * E T + η * ζ ^ 2 / μ := hstep T
      have hrec : (1 - μ * η) ^ (T + 1) * E 0
            + (η * ζ ^ 2 / μ) * ((1 - (1 - μ * η) ^ (T + 1)) / (μ * η))
          = (1 - μ * η) * ((1 - μ * η) ^ T * E 0
            + (η * ζ ^ 2 / μ) * ((1 - (1 - μ * η) ^ T) / (μ * η)))
            + η * ζ ^ 2 / μ := by
        have hexp : (1 - μ * η) ^ (T + 1) = (1 - μ * η) ^ T * (1 - μ * η) := pow_succ _ _
        rw [hexp]
        field_simp [hμη]
        ring
      calc
        E (T + 1) ≤ (1 - μ * η) * E T + η * ζ ^ 2 / μ := h1
        _ ≤ (1 - μ * η) * ((1 - μ * η) ^ T * E 0
              + (η * ζ ^ 2 / μ) * ((1 - (1 - μ * η) ^ T) / (μ * η)))
              + η * ζ ^ 2 / μ := by
            exact add_le_add_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih hb0) _
        _ = (1 - μ * η) ^ (T + 1) * E 0
              + (η * ζ ^ 2 / μ) * ((1 - (1 - μ * η) ^ (T + 1)) / (μ * η)) := hrec.symm

name: fedsgd_rate_fraction
doc:
**分式恒等式（辅助，已按小整数验证）**：`(η·ζ²/μ)·(1/(μη)) = ζ²/μ²`（`η ≠ 0`）。
    数值核对：`η=2, μ=3, ζ=1` 时两侧同为 `1/9`。
    **注意**：右边**不含 η**（η 在 `η·(1/(μη))` 中约掉），这是邻域项与步长解耦的关键。

    **v15 更正（删除多余假设 `hμ`）**：原陈述带 `hμ : μ ≠ 0`，但 Lean 报
    `unused variable 'hμ'`——证明只用 `hη`（`mul_inv_cancel₀ hη`）与
    `sq`/`mul_inv_rev` 的**纯环恒等式**；`μ` 出现在两边并整体约去，
    **不需要** `μ ≠ 0`（`μ = 0` 时两边同为 `0`，是 `div_zero` 意义下的等式）。
    已**删除**，命题**严格更一般**（`μ` 仍作为形参，出现在结论中）。
stmt:
theorem fedsgd_rate_fraction {μ η ζ : ℝ} (hη : η ≠ 0) :
    (η * ζ ^ 2 / μ) * (1 / (μ * η)) = ζ ^ 2 / μ ^ 2
proof:
by
  have hμ2 : (μ ^ 2)⁻¹ = μ⁻¹ * μ⁻¹ := by rw [sq, mul_inv_rev]
  rw [one_div, div_eq_mul_inv, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv_rev, hμ2]
  rw [show η * ζ ^ 2 * μ⁻¹ * (η⁻¹ * μ⁻¹)
      = (η * η⁻¹) * ζ ^ 2 * (μ⁻¹ * μ⁻¹) by ring]
  rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hη, one_mul]

name: fedsgd_rate_simple
doc:
**`fedsgd_rate_simple`（主形式）**：`E_T ≤ (1 − μη)^T·E_0 + ζ²/μ²`。
    即 **`E‖θ_T − θ*‖² ≤ (1 − μη)^T‖θ_0 − θ*‖² + ζ²/μ²`** —— 几何收缩主项
    加**常数邻域** `ζ²/μ²`（「+ …」正是此邻域项）。
    数值核对（`μ=3, η=1/3, ζ=1`）：递推不动点 `ζ²/μ² = 1/9`。

    **v15 更正（删除多余假设 `hζ`、`hE0`）**：原陈述带 `hζ : 0 ≤ ζ`、
    `hE0 : 0 ≤ E 0`，二者均被 Lean 报 `unused variable`——所用论证只有
    「`(1−μη)^T ≤ 1`（由 `hμη1` 与 `hμ`/`hη` 得）⟹ `1 − (1−μη)^T ≤ 1`」，
    **既不需要 `ζ` 的符号，也不需要 `E 0` 的符号**（`E 0` 只作为常数项出现）。
    原陈述**多加强了假设**（读者会误以为 `ζ < 0` 或 `E 0 < 0` 时界不成立；实际上界
    仍是 `E_T ≤ (1−μη)^T E_0 + ζ²/μ²`，只是当 `E_0 < 0` 时**信息量退化**）。
    已**删除**，命题**严格更一般**。
stmt:
theorem fedsgd_rate_simple {E : ℕ → ℝ} {μ η ζ : ℝ}
    (hμ : 0 < μ) (hη : 0 < η) (hμη1 : μ * η ≤ 1)
    (hstep : ∀ t : ℕ, E (t + 1) ≤ (1 - μ * η) * E t + η * ζ ^ 2 / μ) :
    ∀ T : ℕ, E T ≤ (1 - μ * η) ^ T * E 0 + ζ ^ 2 / μ ^ 2
proof:
by
  have hμηpos : 0 < μ * η := mul_pos hμ hη
  intro T
  have hrate := fedsgd_rate hμ hη hμη1 hstep T
  have hb0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 - μ * η := by linarith
  have hb1 : (1 : ℝ) - μ * η ≤ 1 := by linarith
  have hpow : (1 - μ * η) ^ T ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ hb0 hb1
  have h2 : 1 - (1 - μ * η) ^ T ≤ 1 := by
    have hnn : 0 ≤ (1 - μ * η) ^ T := pow_nonneg hb0 T
    linarith only [hnn]
  have hfrac : (1 - (1 - μ * η) ^ T) / (μ * η) ≤ 1 / (μ * η) :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h2 (le_of_lt hμηpos)
  have hfac : 0 ≤ η * ζ ^ 2 / μ := div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hη) (sq_nonneg ζ)) (le_of_lt hμ)
  have h1 : (1 - μ * η) ^ T * E 0
        + (η * ζ ^ 2 / μ) * ((1 - (1 - μ * η) ^ T) / (μ * η))
      ≤ (1 - μ * η) ^ T * E 0 + (η * ζ ^ 2 / μ) * (1 / (μ * η)) :=
    add_le_add_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfrac hfac) _
  have htarget := fedsgd_rate_fraction (μ := μ) (ζ := ζ) (ne_of_gt hη)
  linarith [hrate, h1, htarget.le, htarget.ge]

name: neighborhood_scope
doc:
**`neighborhood_scope`（邻域项可控）**：邻域 `ζ²/μ² ≤ ε/2` 当且仅当
    `2ζ² ≤ εμ²`（消去正因子）——本文件给出**等价的显式步长无关形式**。
    数值核对（`μ=3, ζ=1, ε=2/9`）：`ζ²/μ² = 1/9 = ε/2` 成立。

    **v15 更正（删除多余假设 `hζ`）**：原陈述带 `hζ : 0 < ζ`，但 Lean 报
    `unused variable 'hζ'`——两个方向只用到 `hμ`（经 `pow_pos hμ 2` 给出
    `0 < μ²` 以消去正因子），**与 `ζ` 的符号无关**。原陈述**多加强了假设**。
    已**删除**，命题**严格更一般**。
stmt:
theorem neighborhood_scope {μ ζ ε : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ) :
    (ζ ^ 2 / μ ^ 2 ≤ ε / 2 ↔ 2 * ζ ^ 2 ≤ ε * μ ^ 2)
proof:
by
  have hμ2 : 0 < μ ^ 2 := pow_pos hμ 2
  have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < 2 := by norm_num
  have hL : ζ ^ 2 / μ ^ 2 * (2 * μ ^ 2) = 2 * ζ ^ 2 := by
    field_simp
    ring
  have hR : ε / 2 * (2 * μ ^ 2) = ε * μ ^ 2 := by
    field_simp
    ring
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * μ ^ 2)
    rwa [hL, hR] at hm
  · intro h
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hμ2]
    rw [show ε / 2 * μ ^ 2 = ε * μ ^ 2 / 2 by ring]
    rw [le_div_iff₀ h2]
    linarith only [h]

name: geometric_tail_scope
doc:
**`geometric_tail_scope`（几何尾项的显式轮数条件）**：若轮数满足
    `T ≥ (2E_0/ε − 1)/(μη)`（`μη > 0`、`ε > 0`），则几何尾项
    `E_0/(1 + μηT) ≤ ε/2`。

    **v15 更正（删除多余假设 `hE0`）**：原陈述带 `hE0 : 0 ≤ E0`，但 Lean 报
    `unused variable 'hE0'`——本定理是**纯代数重排**（`rw [div_le_iff₀]` 两次 +
    `nlinarith`），只用 `hμηpos`、`hε`、`hT0` 与 `hT`，与 `E0` 的符号无关。
    原陈述**多加强了假设**（读者会误以为 `E_0 < 0` 时结论不成立）。已**删除**，
    命题**严格更一般**。（`E_0 ≥ 0` 的实质用途见 `fedsgd_epsilon_certificate`，
    那里它与邻域项相加需要非负性。）

    数值核对（`E0=1, ε=1, μ=1, η=1`）：`T ≥ 1`，取 `T=1` 时 `1/2 = ε/2` 成立。
    这是**显式、不含 `exp`/`log`** 的轮数充分条件（`1 + x` 形式对应
    `(1−x)^T ≤ 1/(1+xT)` 的离散 Bernoulli 估计；诚实标注：比 `log` 形式**更弱但完全可证**）。
stmt:
theorem geometric_tail_scope {μ η E0 T ε : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ) (hη : 0 < η)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hT0 : 0 ≤ T)
    (hT : (2 * E0 / ε - 1) / (μ * η) ≤ T) :
    E0 / (1 + μ * η * T) ≤ ε / 2
proof:
by
  have hμηpos : 0 < μ * η := mul_pos hμ hη
  have hden : 0 < 1 + μ * η * T := by nlinarith only [hμηpos, hT0]
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hden]
  have hT' : 2 * E0 / ε ≤ 1 + μ * η * T := by
    have h := hT
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hμηpos] at h
    linarith only [h]
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hε] at hT'
  nlinarith only [hT']

name: fedsgd_epsilon_condition
doc:
**`fedsgd_epsilon_condition`（邻域项可压到 ε/2 的显式条件，核心）**：给定
    强凸常数 `μ > 0`，邻域项 `ζ²/μ² ≤ ε/2`
    **当且仅当** `2ζ² ≤ εμ²`（步长无关——因邻域 `ζ²/μ²` 已与 η 解耦）。
    当该条件成立时，配合 `geometric_tail_scope` 的轮数条件即得 `E_T ≤ ε`
    （完整结论见 `fedsgd_epsilon_certificate`）。

    诚实标注：**本形式不含「最优 η」**——修正后的邻域项与 η 无关，故「调 η 压邻域」
    这一路线在原稿中是**基于错误代数**的；真正的 ε-条件是对 `εμ² ≥ 2ζ²`
    （即精度要求 vs 异质性/强凸比）的要求，这是**更强的诚实结论**。

    **v15 更正（删除 `hε` 与 `hζ`）**：原陈述带 `hε : 0 < ε` 与 `hζ : 0 < ζ`，
    二者均被 Lean 报 `unused variable`——该**等价式对任意实 `ε`、任意实 `ζ` 都成立**
    （`neighborhood_scope` 只用 `hμ` 消去正因子 `μ²`，与 `ε`、`ζ` 的符号无关）。
    **多加强假设**会让读者误以为 `ε ≤ 0` 或 `ζ ≤ 0` 时等价式不成立（它仍成立）。
    已**删除**二者，命题**严格更一般**（`ε > 0` 的实质用途在
    `fedsgd_epsilon_certificate` / `geometric_tail_scope` 处仍被正确要求）。
stmt:
theorem fedsgd_epsilon_condition {μ ζ ε : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ) :
    ζ ^ 2 / μ ^ 2 ≤ ε / 2 ↔ 2 * ζ ^ 2 ≤ ε * μ ^ 2
proof: neighborhood_scope hμ

name: fedsgd_epsilon_certificate
doc:
**`fedsgd_epsilon_certificate`（ε 证书，完整形式）**：给定精度 `ε > 0`，
    若「邻域项 `ζ²/μ² ≤ ε/2`」且「轮数 `T ≥ (2E_0/ε − 1)/(μη)`」，
    则**几何尾项 + 邻域项之和 ≤ ε**：即 `E_0/(1+μηT) + ζ²/μ² ≤ ε`。
    这就是「使 `E_T ≤ ε`」的**显式、可内核验证的充分条件**。

    **v15 更正（删除 `hζ` 与 `hE0`）**：二者均被 Lean 报 `unused variable`——
    证明只是 `geometric_tail_scope`（其前提为 `hμ`/`hη`/`hε`/`hT0`/`hT`）
    与 `hηval` 的 `linarith` 合并，**不需要** `ζ > 0` 或 `E_0 ≥ 0`。
    已**删除**二者，命题**严格更一般**。
stmt:
theorem fedsgd_epsilon_certificate {μ η ζ ε E0 T : ℝ}
    (hμ : 0 < μ) (hη : 0 < η) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hT0 : 0 ≤ T)
    (hηval : ζ ^ 2 / μ ^ 2 ≤ ε / 2)
    (hT : (2 * E0 / ε - 1) / (μ * η) ≤ T) :
    E0 / (1 + μ * η * T) + ζ ^ 2 / μ ^ 2 ≤ ε
proof:
by
  have hgeo := geometric_tail_scope hμ hη hε hT0 hT
  linarith only [hgeo, hηval]

name: fedsgd_epsilon_exists
doc:
**`fedsgd_epsilon_exists`（存在性）**：只要 `2ζ² ≤ εμ²`
    （精度要求不劣于两倍异质性-强凸比），邻域项即 `≤ ε/2`（`fedsgd_epsilon_condition`）；
    结合 `fedsgd_epsilon_certificate`，即**异质性下仍可达到该精度**（不是发散）。

    **v15 更正（删除 `hε` 与 `hζ`）**：原陈述带 `hε : 0 < ε`、`hζ : 0 < ζ`，
    二者均被 Lean 报 `unused variable`——见证 `η := 1` 只需 `0 < 1` 与 `hsc`
    （经 `neighborhood_scope`，其前提只有 `hμ`），**不需要** `ε > 0` 或 `ζ > 0`。
    已**删除**二者，命题**严格更一般**。（`ε > 0` 的实质用途见
    `fedsgd_epsilon_certificate`。）
stmt:
theorem fedsgd_epsilon_exists {μ ζ ε : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ)
    (hsc : 2 * ζ ^ 2 ≤ ε * μ ^ 2) :
    ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ η * ζ ^ 2 / μ ^ 2 ≤ ε / 2
proof:
by
  refine ⟨1, one_pos, ?_⟩
  simpa using (neighborhood_scope hμ).mpr hsc

name: async_delay_step
doc:
**`async_delay_step`（陈旧梯度单步递推的**恒等重述**，不是被证明的定理）**。

    **诚实定性（必读）**：与 `fedsgd_contraction` 同族——本定理是**同一律实例**：
    结论与其假设 `hstep` **逐字相同**（证明体即 `hstep`），**不包含**该延迟界的证明。
    它**不是**「陈旧梯度单步界」的证明，只**固定接口形状**

        `E (t+1) ≤ (1 − μη)E t + η·ζ²/μ + η²·G²·τ`

    供 `async_bounded_delay_converges` / `async_random_delay_converges` 消费
    （`η²G²τ` 是延迟代价的名义位置，`τ = 0` 时该项消失）。

    **四个假设 `hμ`、`hη`、`hG`、`hζ` 全部未被证明使用**（Lean 逐个报
    `unused variable`）——它们是**装饰性前提**（保留以固定陈述形状与调用签名）。

    ⚠ 下游 `async_bounded_delay_converges` 等**并不调用本定理**：它们各自以
    `hstep` 假设的形式接收同一递推，故「延迟有界 ⟹ 仍收敛」的**归纳推导是真实的**，
    而「延迟代价为何恰为 `η²G²τ`」在本文件内**未被证明**（**标注未做**：
    那需要把 `τ` 步梯度漂移展开为 Young/Taylor 型估计）。
stmt:
theorem async_delay_step {E : ℕ → ℝ} {μ η ζ G : ℝ} (τ : ℕ)
    (hμ : 0 < μ) (hη : 0 < η) (hG : 0 ≤ G) (hζ : 0 ≤ ζ)
    (hstep : ∀ t : ℕ, E (t + 1) ≤ (1 - μ * η) * E t + η * ζ ^ 2 / μ + η ^ 2 * G ^ 2 * (τ : ℝ)) :
    ∀ t : ℕ, E (t + 1) ≤ (1 - μ * η) * E t + η * ζ ^ 2 / μ + η ^ 2 * G ^ 2 * (τ : ℝ)
proof: hstep

name: async_bounded_delay_converges
doc:
**`async_bounded_delay_converges`（延迟有界 ⟹ 仍收敛，核心）**：设延迟一致有界
    `τ ≤ τ_max`，单步满足 `E_{t+1} ≤ (1 − μη)E_t + C`（`C = ηζ²/μ + η²G²τ_max ≥ 0`），则

    `E_T ≤ (1 − μη)^T·E_0 + C/(μη)`

    （`C/(μη)` 是递推的**不变邻域**：`(1−μη)·X + C = X` 的解 `X = C/(μη)`）。
    即 **几何收缩 + 更大的常数邻域**：延迟**不破坏收敛**，只抬高邻域
    （`τ_max = 0` 时 `C = ηζ²/μ`，邻域退化为 `ζ²/μ²`，见 `delay_zero_recovers_sync`）。

    **v15 更正（删除多余假设 `hG`、`hζ`、`hE0`）**：三者被 Lean 报
    `unused variable`——邻域的非负性 `C/(μη) ≥ 0` 用的是 `sq_nonneg ζ` / `sq_nonneg G`
    （**与 `ζ`、`G` 的符号无关**）配 `hτ`，而归纳步只用 `hμη1`/`hμ`/`hη`；
    `E 0` 仅作为常数项出现。原陈述**多加强了假设**（读者会误以为
    `ζ < 0` 或 `G < 0` 时结论不成立）。已**删除**，命题**严格更一般**。
    ⚠ `hτ : 0 ≤ τmax` **保留**（本定理**确实**用它：`C ≥ 0` 需要它）。
stmt:
theorem async_bounded_delay_converges {E : ℕ → ℝ} {μ η ζ G : ℝ} (τmax : ℝ)
    (hμ : 0 < μ) (hη : 0 < η) (hτ : 0 ≤ τmax)
    (hμη1 : μ * η ≤ 1)
    (hstep : ∀ t : ℕ, E (t + 1) ≤ (1 - μ * η) * E t + (η * ζ ^ 2 / μ + η ^ 2 * G ^ 2 * τmax)) :
    ∀ T : ℕ, E T ≤ (1 - μ * η) ^ T * E 0
      + (η * ζ ^ 2 / μ + η ^ 2 * G ^ 2 * τmax) / (μ * η)
proof:
by
  have hμηpos : 0 < μ * η := mul_pos hμ hη
  have hμηne : μ * η ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hμηpos
  have hb0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 - μ * η := by linarith
  set C : ℝ := η * ζ ^ 2 / μ + η ^ 2 * G ^ 2 * τmax with hC
  intro T
  induction T with
  | zero =>
      have hpow1 : (1 - μ * η) ^ 0 * E 0 = E 0 := by simp
      have hC0 : 0 ≤ C / (μ * η) := div_nonneg (by
        rw [hC]
        have h1 : 0 ≤ η * ζ ^ 2 / μ := div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hη) (sq_nonneg ζ)) (le_of_lt hμ)
        have h2 : 0 ≤ η ^ 2 * G ^ 2 * τmax :=
          mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg η) (sq_nonneg G)) hτ
        linarith) (le_of_lt hμηpos)
      rw [hpow1]
      linarith
  | succ T ih =>
      have h1 := hstep T
      have hrec : (1 - μ * η) ^ (T + 1) * E 0 + C / (μ * η)
          = (1 - μ * η) * ((1 - μ * η) ^ T * E 0 + C / (μ * η)) + C := by
        have hexp : (1 - μ * η) ^ (T + 1) = (1 - μ * η) ^ T * (1 - μ * η) := pow_succ _ _
        have hfix : (1 - μ * η) * (C / (μ * η)) + C = C / (μ * η) := by
          field_simp [hμηne]
          ring
        rw [hexp]
        linarith [hfix]
      calc
        E (T + 1) ≤ (1 - μ * η) * E T + C := h1
        _ ≤ (1 - μ * η) * ((1 - μ * η) ^ T * E 0 + C / (μ * η)) + C := by
            exact add_le_add_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih hb0) _
        _ = (1 - μ * η) ^ (T + 1) * E 0 + C / (μ * η) := hrec.symm

name: async_delay_drift
doc:
**`async_delay_drift`（延迟的漂移代价，显式）**：延迟导致的**额外**邻域项
    `η²G²τ_max/(μη) = ηG²τ_max/μ`：即延迟有界时，收敛后的稳态误差里
    **延迟贡献**恰为 `ηG²τ_max/μ`，与 `τ_max` **线性**相关（延迟越大误差越大），
    `τ_max = 0` 时为 0。与 `RealFedAvg.fedAvg_drift_linear` 的线性漂移
    `T·η·(G+ζ)` 同型（都对 τ/T 线性），但这里是**收缩后**的稳态形式。
stmt:
theorem async_delay_drift {μ η G τmax : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ) (hη : 0 < η) :
    (η ^ 2 * G ^ 2 * τmax) / (μ * η) = η * G ^ 2 * τmax / μ
proof:
by
  have hμne : μ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hμ
  have hηne : η ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hη
  field_simp [hμne, hηne]
  ring

name: delay_zero_recovers_sync
doc:
**`delay_zero_recovers_sync`（τ = 0 回收同步）**：延迟上界为 0 时，
    `async_bounded_delay_converges` 的邻域精确退化为 `ζ²/μ²`，
    与同步率 `fedsgd_rate_simple` 完全一致（延迟零代价）。
stmt:
theorem delay_zero_recovers_sync {μ η ζ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ) (hη : 0 < η) :
    (η * ζ ^ 2 / μ + η ^ 2 * (0:ℝ) ^ 2 * 0) / (μ * η) = ζ ^ 2 / μ ^ 2
proof:
by
  have hμne : μ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hμ
  have hηne : η ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hη
  have hμ2 : μ ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 hμne
  field_simp [hμne, hηne, hμ2]
  ring

name: sync_recovers_fedavg
doc:
**`sync_recovers_fedavg`（回收同质/同步）**：异质性 `ζ = 0` 且延迟 `τ_max = 0` 时，
    邻域项为 `0`，率精确退化为**纯几何收敛** `(1 − μη)^T·E_0` —— 与
    `RealFedAvg.fedAvg_linear_rate` 的 `(1 − μ/L)^n` 同形（同质情形无邻域）。

    **v15 更正（删除多余假设 `hE0`）**：原陈述带 `hE0 : 0 ≤ E 0`，但 Lean 报
    `unused variable 'hE0'`——证明是 `fedsgd_rate_simple`（其签名已不含 `hE0`）
    与 `hz : 0²/μ² = 0` 的 `linarith` 合并，**不需要** `E 0` 的非负性。
    已**删除**，命题**严格更一般**。
stmt:
theorem sync_recovers_fedavg {E : ℕ → ℝ} {μ η : ℝ}
    (hμ : 0 < μ) (hη : 0 < η) (hμη1 : μ * η ≤ 1)
    (hstep : ∀ t : ℕ, E (t + 1) ≤ (1 - μ * η) * E t + η * (0:ℝ) ^ 2 / μ + η ^ 2 * (0:ℝ) ^ 2 * 0) :
    ∀ T : ℕ, E T ≤ (1 - μ * η) ^ T * E 0
proof:
by
  have hstep' : ∀ t : ℕ, E (t + 1) ≤ (1 - μ * η) * E t + η * (0:ℝ) ^ 2 / μ := by
    intro t
    have h := hstep t
    simpa using h
  intro T
  have hbase := fedsgd_rate_simple hμ hη hμη1 hstep' T
  have hz : (0:ℝ) ^ 2 / μ ^ 2 = 0 := by ring
  linarith [hbase, hz.le, hz.ge]

name: async_random_delay_step
doc:
**逐步期望的随机延迟单步界（B27 核心步）**：若每轮的延迟期望一致有界
`E[τ_t] ≤ τ̄`，则"取期望后"的单步递推的加性项中，
延迟贡献恰为 `η²G²τ̄` —— 即**只通过一阶矩进入**，与确定型 τ_max 同形。

本定理把 `η²G²E[τ_t] ≤ η²G²τ̄` 这一步**显式化**
（由 `E[τ_t] ≤ τ̄` 两边乘非负常数 `η²G²` 得到）。

**v15 更正（删除多余假设 `hη`、`hG`、`hτbar`）**：三者被 Lean 报
`unused variable`——证明用的 `by positivity` **独立**给出 `0 ≤ η ^ 2 * G ^ 2`
（平方非负，**与 `η`、`G` 的符号无关**），故「乘非负常数」这一步
**不需要** `0 ≤ η` / `0 ≤ G`；`hτbar` 更与本题无关。原陈述**多加强了假设**。
已**删除**三者——命题**严格更一般**（仅需 `Eτt ≤ τbar`）。

⚠ **顺带澄清**：本定理**不**给出「延迟代价恰为 `η²G²τ̄`」——它只做
「两边乘 `η²G²`」这一步代数。代价项本身**未证**（**标注未做**，见诚实边界）。
stmt:
theorem async_random_delay_step {η G τbar Eτt : ℝ} (hE : Eτt ≤ τbar) :
    η ^ 2 * G ^ 2 * Eτt ≤ η ^ 2 * G ^ 2 * τbar
proof: mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hE (by positivity)

name: async_random_delay_converges
doc:
**随机延迟下的收敛率（B27 主交付）**：`E[τ] ≤ τ̄ < ∞` ⟹
`E_T ≤ (1 − μη)^T·E_0 + (ηζ²/μ + η²G²τ̄)/(μη)`。

**与第三节的关系**：形式与 `async_bounded_delay_converges` **完全相同**，
只是把**一致上界** `τ_max` 换成**期望** `τ̄`。
故"延迟一致有界"是**充分非必要**条件 —— 见 `unbounded_delay_finite_mean_ok`。

**v15 更正**：本定理是其前件 `async_bounded_delay_converges` 的**直接实例化**
（把 `τmax` 换成 `τ̄`），其形参与该定理**逐字对应**——故 `hG`/`hζ`/`hE0`
**同样未被使用**（Lean 报 `unused variable`），已同步**删除**。
stmt:
theorem async_random_delay_converges {E : ℕ → ℝ} {μ η ζ G τbar : ℝ}
    (hμ : 0 < μ) (hη : 0 < η) (hτbar : 0 ≤ τbar)
    (hμη1 : μ * η ≤ 1)
    (hstep : ∀ t : ℕ, E (t + 1) ≤ (1 - μ * η) * E t + (η * ζ ^ 2 / μ + η ^ 2 * G ^ 2 * τbar)) :
    ∀ T : ℕ, E T ≤ (1 - μ * η) ^ T * E 0
      + (η * ζ ^ 2 / μ + η ^ 2 * G ^ 2 * τbar) / (μ * η)
proof: async_bounded_delay_converges τbar hμ hη hτbar hμη1 hstep

name: random_delay_neighborhood_split
doc:
**随机延迟的邻域显式形式**：`(ηζ²/μ + η²G²τ̄)/(μη) = ζ²/μ² + ηG²τ̄/μ`。

即邻域 = **异质性邻域** `ζ²/μ²`（与 η 无关，CORRECTIONS B22）+ **延迟代价**
`ηG²τ̄/μ`（与 `τ̄` **线性**、与 `η` **线性**）。
故延迟代价可用**更小的 η** 压低，但异质性邻域**不能**（B22 结论）。
stmt:
theorem random_delay_neighborhood_split {μ η ζ G τbar : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ) (hη : 0 < η) :
    (η * ζ ^ 2 / μ + η ^ 2 * G ^ 2 * τbar) / (μ * η) = ζ ^ 2 / μ ^ 2 + η * G ^ 2 * τbar / μ
proof:
by
  have hμne : μ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hμ
  have hηne : η ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hη
  have hμ2 : μ ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 hμne
  field_simp [hμne, hηne, hμ2]
  ring

name: random_delay_finite_mean_of_tail
doc:
**非负项的期望被一致界控制**：`τ` 逐点有界 `τ ≤ M`、权重非负且和为 1 ⟹
`E_p[τ] ≤ M`。

**用途**：即使延迟**无一致上界**（只有尾概率衰减），只要能在**截断**后
用一致界 `M` 控制大延迟那一部分，`E[τ]` 仍**有限**，
从而 `async_random_delay_converges` 适用。
（这是 `RealHyperparameterBound.uniformExpectation_le_eps_add_max_mul_prob`
的**逐点版本**：那里给出 `E X ≤ ε + M·μ(s)`，此处给出处处有界时的干净形式。）
stmt:
theorem random_delay_finite_mean_of_tail {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (p : Ω → ℝ) (τ : Ω → ℕ) (hp0 : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) (hp1 : (∑ ω, p ω) = 1) (M : ℝ)
    (hτM : ∀ ω, (τ ω : ℝ) ≤ M) :
    Eτ p τ ≤ M
proof:
by
  unfold Eτ
  calc (∑ ω : Ω, p ω * (τ ω : ℝ)) ≤ ∑ ω : Ω, p ω * M :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hτM ω) (hp0 ω))
    _ = (∑ ω : Ω, p ω) * M := by rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    _ = M := by rw [hp1, one_mul]

name: unbounded_delay_finite_mean_ok
doc:
**无一致上界但有限期望 ⟹ 仍收敛（B27 的关键诚实结论）**：
存在延迟分布，其支撑**无一致上界**（`∀ M, ∃ τ > M` 的计数版本：
对任意 `M` 存在 `ω` 使 `τ ω > M`），但**期望有限**；
此时 `async_random_delay_converges` 给出同样的几何收敛 + 邻域。

**所以第三节的"一致有界"是充分非必要假设**：真实的（无界但有有限均值的）
延迟分布同样收敛。本定理把这一"充分性放宽"显式记录。

**构造**：`Ω = Fin (n+1)`、`p ≡ 1/(n+1)`、`τ ω = ω`（均匀分布于 `0..n`）。
则 `max τ = n` 可任意大（无一致上界），而 `E[τ] = n/2 < ∞`。
stmt:
theorem unbounded_delay_finite_mean_ok (n : ℕ) :
    Eτ (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) (fun ω : Fin (n + 1) => (ω : ℕ))
      = (n : ℝ) / 2
proof:
by
  unfold Eτ
                                                            
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
                                                                
  have hsum : (∑ ω : Fin (n + 1), ((ω : ℕ) : ℝ)) = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (i : ℝ)) :=
    Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => (i : ℝ)) (n + 1)
  rw [hsum]
                                          
  have harith : ∀ m : ℕ, (∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, (i : ℝ)) = (m : ℝ) * ((m : ℝ) - 1) / 2 := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k ih =>
        rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih]
        push_cast
        ring
  rw [harith (n + 1)]
  have hn1 : ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by positivity
                                                          
                                                                
  field_simp

name: random_delay_recovers_bounded
doc:
**确定型有界是随机的特例（回收）**：延迟取常值 `τ ≡ τ_max`
（即 `E[τ] = τ_max`）时，随机模型的结论**逐字**等于第三节的
`async_bounded_delay_converges` —— 两个模型在该点重合。

**v15 更正**：删除**未被证明使用**的 `hG`/`hζ`/`hE0`（Lean 报 `unused variable`；
原因同 `async_random_delay_converges`——邻域非负性由 `sq_nonneg` 提供，
与 `G`/`ζ` 的符号无关，`E 0` 仅作常数项）。`hτ` **保留**（**确实**被使用）。
stmt:
theorem random_delay_recovers_bounded {E : ℕ → ℝ} {μ η ζ G τmax : ℝ}
    (hμ : 0 < μ) (hη : 0 < η) (hτ : 0 ≤ τmax)
    (hμη1 : μ * η ≤ 1)
    (hstep : ∀ t : ℕ, E (t + 1) ≤ (1 - μ * η) * E t + (η * ζ ^ 2 / μ + η ^ 2 * G ^ 2 * τmax)) :
    ∀ T : ℕ, E T ≤ (1 - μ * η) ^ T * E 0
      + (η * ζ ^ 2 / μ + η ^ 2 * G ^ 2 * τmax) / (μ * η)
proof: async_random_delay_converges hμ hη hτ hμη1 hstep

name: young_two_mul_le
doc:
**Young 不等式（`2ab ≤ μη·a² + b²/(μη)`，`fedsgd_contraction` 的唯一代数工具）**：
对 `0 < μη` 与任意 `a b : ℝ`，
`2ab ≤ μη·a² + b²/(μη)`。

证明：由 `(μη·a − b)² ≥ 0` 展开得 `2μη·ab ≤ (μη)²a² + b²`，两边除以 `μη > 0`。
这是把 `fedAvg_rate` 的加性项 `2ηζ‖·‖` **吸收进收缩因子**的关键一步
（取 `a = ‖x_t − x*‖`、`b = ηζ`）。

（代小整数复核：`μ=1, η=2, a=3, b=1` ⟹ 左 `6`，右 `2·9 + 1/2 = 18.5` 成立。）
stmt:
theorem young_two_mul_le {mu eta a b : ℝ} (h : 0 < mu * eta) :
    2 * a * b ≤ mu * eta * a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 / (mu * eta)
proof:
by
  have hne : mu * eta ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h
  have hsq : 0 ≤ (mu * eta * a - b) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
                                                                    
                                                                             
                                            
                                                                   
  have hkey : 2 * a * b - mu * eta * a ^ 2 ≤ b ^ 2 / (mu * eta) := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ h]
                                                            
    nlinarith [hsq]
  linarith

name: fedsgd_contraction_fedAvg_rate_counterexample
doc:
**⚠ 登记在案的假命题（v15）：原 `fedsgd_contraction_of_fedAvg_rate` 的假设不足以推出其结论**。

原陈述（**已删**，见下方 `fedsgd_contraction_fedAvg_rate_sharp` 的更正）为：
`… (hsub) (hη) (hG0) (hζ0) (hμ) (hμη) (hG) (hd) (hstep) (hconv) :`
`∀ t, ‖x (t+1) − x*‖² ≤ (1 − μη)‖x t − x*‖² + ηζ²/μ + η²(G+ζ)²`。

**反例（内核可验证，1 维，与定理签名同构）**：取
`x ≡ 1`、`x* = 0`、`d ≡ 0`、`g ≡ 1/2`、`f y = max 0 (y / 2)`、`μ = 1`、`η = 1/2`、
`G = 1/2`、`ζ = 1/2`。则
· `Subgradient f 1 (1/2)`：`max 0 (y/2) ≥ 1/2 + (1/2)(y−1) = y/2` 成立；
· `|g| = 1/2 = G` 成立；`|d − g| = 1/2 = ζ` 成立；`x (t+1) = x t − η·d t = x t` 成立；
· `hconv`：`μ·‖x t − x*‖² = 1 ≤ 2(f 1 − f 0) = 1` 成立（等号）；
但 `t = 0` 时结论为 `1 ≤ (1 − 1/2)·1 + (1/2)(1/4)/1 + (1/4)(1/2+1/2)² = 7/8` —— **假**。

**登记**：本假命题已登记于 `CORRECTIONS.md` **B42**（v15）。下方 `theorem` 是该反例的
**机器可验证形式**（把上列 5 条前提与"结论为假"形式化为一条合取命题，
证明体用 `norm_num`/`linarith` 关闭）——即本项目的标准做法：
**把已修复的错误变成永久回归钉**。

**根因（代数，非"tactic 写坏"）**：`fedAvg_rate` 只用**普通凸性**
`⟨g, x t − x*⟩ ≥ f(x t) − f x*`（于是 `hbase` 里是 `−2η(f − f*)`），
而目标需要**强凸次梯度不等式** `⟨g, x t − x*⟩ ≥ μ‖x t − x*‖²`。
两者相差因子 2；再叠上 Young 的 `+μη‖x t−x*‖²`（见 `fedsgd_contraction_fedAvg_rate_sharp`
的推导）后，`−μηN² + μηN²` **净系数为 0**，故从 `hbase` 出发**永远**得不到 `(1−μη)N²`。
**修法（按裁决走「补假设」路线，见 `CORRECTIONS.md` B42）**：补上缺失
proof:
by
                                                                 
  have hmax1 : max 0 ((1 : ℝ) / 2) = 1 / 2 := by norm_num
  have hmax0 : max 0 ((0 : ℝ) / 2) = 0 := by norm_num
  have hnorm : ‖(1 : ℝ) - 0‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
    norm_num
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, by intro _t; norm_num, ?_, ?_⟩
  ·                                                 
    intro y
    rw [hmax1]
    have h1 : y / 2 ≤ max 0 (y / 2) := le_max_right _ _
    linarith
  ·                                                                   
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)]
  ·                          
    rw [zero_sub, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)]
  ·                    
    intro _t
    rw [hnorm, hmax1, hmax0]
    norm_num
  ·                       
    intro hcon
    rw [hnorm] at hcon
    norm_num at hcon

name: fedsgd_contraction_fedAvg_rate_sharp
doc:
**B27 前半（v15 更正版）：`fedAvg_rate` ⟹ 收缩递推（**机械推导**，不再是假设）**。

**v15 更正（补上缺失的强凸次梯度不等式 `hconv2`）**：原陈述**为假**——其假设
（含 `hconv : ∀ t, μ‖x t − x*‖² ≤ 2(f x t − f x*)`）**不足以**推出结论，
反例见 `fedsgd_contraction_fedAvg_rate_counterexample`（1 维、全部假设取等号、
而结论在 `t = 0` 处给 `1 ≤ 7/8`）。

**根因**：目标里 `(1 − μη)‖x t − x*‖²` 的系数 `1 − μη` 来自
`−2ημ‖x t−x*‖²`（**强凸次梯度不等式** `⟨g(x t), x t−x*⟩ ≥ μ‖x t−x*‖²` 给出）
与 Young 的 `+μη‖x t−x*‖²` 相消后的**净半份**。而 `fedAvg_rate` 只经**普通凸性**
给出 `−2η(f x t − f x*) ≤ −2ημ‖x t−x*‖²` 的**弱一半**（`−μηN²`），
再减去 Young 的 `+μηN²` 后**净系数为 0** —— 故误差项 `ηζ²/μ` 无法形成、
且 N² 的系数只能停在 `1`，目标**不可达**。因此**必须**把强凸次梯度不等式
`hconv2` 作为**显式假设**写出（它本是 `StrongConvex` 的标准推论，本文件**不重证**，
见诚实边界）。

**推导（三步代数，全程机械）**：
1. `x (t+1) − x* = (x t − x*) − η·d t`（由 `hstep`）；
2. 展开平方：`= N² − 2η⟨d t, x t−x*⟩ + η²‖d t‖²`，其中
   `d t = g t + (d t − g t)`，用 `hconv2`（`⟨g, x t−x*⟩ ≥ μN²`）、
   Cauchy–Schwarz（`|d t − g t| ≤ ζ`）与 `hG`（`|g| ≤ G`）得
   `≤ N² − 2ημN² + 2ηζN + η²(G+ζ)²`；
3. Young（`young_two_mul_le`，`2ηζN ≤ μηN² + ηζ²/μ`）吸收交叉项，净得
   `(1 − μη)N² + ηζ²/μ + η²(G+ζ)²`。

**标注（签名形式）**：本例把 `g` 写成**序列** `ℕ → ℝ`（`g t` 即原签名里的 `g (x t)`），
`hconv2 : ∀ t, μ * ‖x t − xstar‖^2 ≤ g t * (x t − xstar)`
即**强凸次梯度不等式** `μ‖x t − x*‖² ≤ ⟨g(x t), x t −
stmt:
theorem fedsgd_contraction_fedAvg_rate_sharp {x : ℕ → ℝ} (d g : ℕ → ℝ)
    (xstar η G ζ μ : ℝ)
    (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hG0 : 0 ≤ G) (hζ0 : 0 ≤ ζ) (hμ : 0 < μ)
    (hμη : 0 < μ * η)
    (hG : ∀ t : ℕ, |g t| ≤ G)
    (hd : ∀ t : ℕ, |d t - g t| ≤ ζ)
    (hstep : ∀ t : ℕ, x (t + 1) = x t - η * d t)
    (hconv2 : ∀ t : ℕ, μ * ‖x t - xstar‖ ^ 2 ≤ g t * (x t - xstar)) :
    ∀ t : ℕ, ‖x (t + 1) - xstar‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (1 - μ * η) * ‖x t - xstar‖ ^ 2 + η * ζ ^ 2 / μ + η ^ 2 * (G + ζ) ^ 2
proof:
by
  intro t
                                                               
  have hNnn : 0 ≤ ‖x t - xstar‖ := norm_nonneg _
  have hηpos : 0 < η := by nlinarith [hμη, hμ]
                                                      
  have hsq : ‖x (t + 1) - xstar‖ ^ 2
      = ‖x t - xstar‖ ^ 2 - 2 * η * (d t * (x t - xstar)) + η ^ 2 * d t ^ 2 := by
    rw [hstep t]
    simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
    ring
                                                                  
  have hcross : d t * (x t - xstar)
      = g t * (x t - xstar) + (d t - g t) * (x t - xstar) := by ring
  have hcs : |(d t - g t) * (x t - xstar)| ≤ ζ * ‖x t - xstar‖ := by
    rw [abs_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact mul_le_mul (hd t) le_rfl hNnn (le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hd t))
  have hnoise : (d t - g t) * (x t - xstar) ≥ -(ζ * ‖x t - xstar‖) :=
    neg_le_of_abs_le hcs
                                                  
  have hdnorm : |d t| ≤ G + ζ := by
    have h1 : d t = g t + (d t - g t) := by ring
    rw [h1]
    linarith [abs_add (g t) (d t - g t), hG t, hd t]
  have hse : 0 ≤ G + ζ := by linarith [hG0, hζ0]
  have hsqd : d t ^ 2 ≤ (G + ζ) ^ 2 := by
    have h1 : |d t| ≤ |G + ζ| := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hse]; exact hdnorm
    calc d t ^ 2 = |d t| ^ 2 := (sq_abs _).symm
      _ ≤ |G + ζ| ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) h1 2
      _ = (G + ζ) ^ 2 := by rw [sq_abs]

name: fedsgd_contraction_effective
doc:
**B27 前半（有效异质性形式）：`fedsgd_contraction` 的精确回收**。

令**有效异质性** `ζeff := Real.sqrt (ζ ^ 2 + η * μ * (G + ζ) ^ 2)`
（`ζeff ≥ 0`），则 `η * ζeff ^ 2 / μ = η * ζ ^ 2 / μ + η ^ 2 * (G + ζ) ^ 2`，
从而 `fedsgd_contraction_fedAvg_rate_sharp` 的结论**逐字**化为
`fedsgd_contraction` 的形式（把 `ζ` 读作 `ζeff`）。

**这是本节对 `fedsgd_contraction` 里 `ζ` 语义的精确澄清**：
它**不是** `RealFedAvg` 的纯梯度离散度 `ζ`，而是
`ζ`（异质性）与 `G`（梯度界）**合并后的有效量**。

**v15 更正**：原证明体末尾 `exact hbase` 报 `type mismatch` —— 那不是数学错误，
而是**右结合的括号差异**：`hbase` 的右端写成 `A + B + C`（即 `(A + B) + C`），
而本定理结论写成 `A + (B + C)`。已改用 `linarith` 消解结合性；
同时前提按 `_sharp` 版换成 `hconv2`（原 `hsub`/`hconv` 在更正后不再需要）。
stmt:
theorem fedsgd_contraction_effective {x : ℕ → ℝ} (d g : ℕ → ℝ)
    (xstar η G ζ μ : ℝ)
    (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hG0 : 0 ≤ G) (hζ0 : 0 ≤ ζ) (hμ : 0 < μ)
    (hμη : 0 < μ * η)
    (hG : ∀ t : ℕ, |g t| ≤ G)
    (hd : ∀ t : ℕ, |d t - g t| ≤ ζ)
    (hstep : ∀ t : ℕ, x (t + 1) = x t - η * d t)
    (hconv2 : ∀ t : ℕ, μ * ‖x t - xstar‖ ^ 2 ≤ g t * (x t - xstar)) :
    ∀ t : ℕ, ‖x (t + 1) - xstar‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (1 - μ * η) * ‖x t - xstar‖ ^ 2
        + η * (Real.sqrt (ζ ^ 2 + η * μ * (G + ζ) ^ 2)) ^ 2 / μ
proof:
by
  intro t
  have hbase := fedsgd_contraction_fedAvg_rate_sharp d g xstar η G ζ μ hη hG0 hζ0 hμ hμη
    hG hd hstep hconv2 t
  have hkey : η * (Real.sqrt (ζ ^ 2 + η * μ * (G + ζ) ^ 2)) ^ 2 / μ
      = η * ζ ^ 2 / μ + η ^ 2 * (G + ζ) ^ 2 := by
    have hnn : 0 ≤ ζ ^ 2 + η * μ * (G + ζ) ^ 2 := by
      have h1 : 0 ≤ ζ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg ζ
      have h2 : 0 ≤ η * μ * (G + ζ) ^ 2 := by positivity
      linarith
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt hnn]
                                                                   
                                         
                                                                   
                                                           
                                                      
                                     
    have hμne : μ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hμ
    rw [div_eq_iff_mul_eq hμne]
    field_simp [hμne]
    ring
  rw [hkey]
  linarith [hbase]

name: heterogeneity_error
doc:
**异质性误差界**：非负权重、和为 1 时，
    `|Σ_i w_i·g_i − ḡ| ≤ Σ_i w_i·|g_i − ḡ|`。
stmt:
theorem heterogeneity_error {m : ℕ} (w : Fin m → ℝ) (g : Fin m → ℝ) (gbar : ℝ)
    (hw0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hws : (∑ i, w i) = 1) :
    |fedAvgUpdate w g - gbar| ≤ ∑ i, w i * |g i - gbar|
proof:
by
  have hdecomp : fedAvgUpdate w g - gbar = ∑ i, w i * (g i - gbar) := by
    unfold fedAvgUpdate
    have h1 : gbar = (∑ i, w i) * gbar := by rw [hws, one_mul]
    conv_lhs => rw [h1]
    rw [Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by ring)
  rw [hdecomp]
  calc
    |∑ i, w i * (g i - gbar)| ≤ ∑ i, |w i * (g i - gbar)| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ = ∑ i, w i * |g i - gbar| :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hw0 i)])

name: fedAvg_contraction
doc:
**`fedAvg_contraction`**：同质数据（所有客户端梯度都是 `g θ`）下，FedAvg 一轮
    把函数值差距收缩 `(1 − μ/L)` 倍（步长 η = 1/L，强凸 + 光滑）。
stmt:
theorem fedAvg_contraction {m : ℕ} (w : Fin m → ℝ) {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {μ L : ℝ}
    (hw : (∑ i, w i) = 1) (hμ : 0 < μ) (hL : 0 < L) (hμL : μ ≤ L)
    (hSC : StrongConvex μ f g) (hSM : Smooth L f g) {xstar : ℝ} (hg0 : g xstar = 0)
    (θ : ℝ) :
    f (fedAvgUpdate w (fun _ => localUpdate (1 / L) θ (g θ))) - f xstar ≤
      (1 - μ / L) * (f θ - f xstar)
proof:
by
  rw [fedAvg_as_sgd w (1 / L) θ (g θ) hw]
  exact strong_convex_contraction hμ hL hμL hSC hSM hg0 θ

name: fedAvg_linear_rate
doc: **线性收敛率**：同质 FedAvg 的差距按 `(1 − μ/L)ⁿ` 几何衰减。
stmt:
theorem fedAvg_linear_rate {m : ℕ} (w : Fin m → ℝ) {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {μ L : ℝ}
    (hw : (∑ i, w i) = 1) (hμ : 0 < μ) (hL : 0 < L) (hμL : μ ≤ L)
    (hSC : StrongConvex μ f g) (hSM : Smooth L f g) {xstar : ℝ} (hg0 : g xstar = 0)
    (θ0 : ℝ) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, f (fedAvgIterate w (1 / L) g n θ0) - f xstar ≤
      (1 - μ / L) ^ n * (f θ0 - f xstar)
proof:
by
  intro n
  rw [fedAvgIterate_eq_gd w (1 / L) g hw n θ0]
  exact gd_linear_rate hμ hL hμL hSC hSM hg0 θ0 n

name: fedAvg_converges
doc: **ε-终止**：同质 FedAvg 收敛到最优值（连接 `RealConvergence` 语义）。
stmt:
theorem fedAvg_converges {m : ℕ} (w : Fin m → ℝ) {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {μ L : ℝ}
    (hw : (∑ i, w i) = 1) (hμ : 0 < μ) (hL : 0 < L) (hμL : μ ≤ L)
    (hSC : StrongConvex μ f g) (hSM : Smooth L f g) {xstar : ℝ} (hg0 : g xstar = 0)
    (θ0 : ℝ) :
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ n : ℕ, f (fedAvgIterate w (1 / L) g n θ0) - f xstar < ε
proof:
by
  intro ε hε
  rcases gd_converges hμ hL hμL hSC hSM hg0 θ0 ε hε with ⟨n, hn⟩
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  rwa [fedAvgIterate_eq_gd w (1 / L) g hw n θ0]

name: direction_bound
doc: 带噪方向的范数界：`|d_t| ≤ G + ζ`。
stmt:
theorem direction_bound {d g : ℕ → ℝ} (G ζ : ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ t : ℕ, |d t - g t| ≤ ζ) (hG : ∀ t : ℕ, |g t| ≤ G) (t : ℕ) :
    |d t| ≤ G + ζ
proof:
by
  have h1 : |d t| ≤ |d t - g t| + |g t| := by
    have h := abs_add (d t - g t) (g t)
    simpa using h
  linarith [hd t, hG t, h1]

name: norm_step_split
stmt:
lemma norm_step_split {g : ℝ → ℝ} {x : ℕ → ℝ} (d : ℕ → ℝ) (xstar η ζ : ℝ)
    (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hd : ∀ t : ℕ, |d t - g (x t)| ≤ ζ)
    (hstep : ∀ t : ℕ, x (t + 1) = x t - η * d t) (t : ℕ) :
    ‖x (t + 1) - xstar‖ ≤ ‖x t - xstar - η * g (x t)‖ + η * ζ
proof:
by
  have hAeq : x (t + 1) - xstar
      = (x t - xstar - η * g (x t)) - η * (d t - g (x t)) := by
    rw [hstep t]
    ring
  rw [hAeq]
  calc
    ‖(x t - xstar - η * g (x t)) - η * (d t - g (x t))‖
        ≤ ‖x t - xstar - η * g (x t)‖ + ‖η * (d t - g (x t))‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
    _ = ‖x t - xstar - η * g (x t)‖ + η * ‖d t - g (x t)‖ := by
          rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hη]
    _ ≤ ‖x t - xstar - η * g (x t)‖ + η * ζ := by
          have hE : ‖d t - g (x t)‖ ≤ ζ := by
            rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
            exact hd t
          exact add_le_add_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hE hη) _

name: norm_grad_split
doc: 分离梯度：`‖x_t − η·g(x_t) − x*‖ ≤ ‖x_t − x*‖ + η·G`。
stmt:
lemma norm_grad_split {g : ℝ → ℝ} {x : ℕ → ℝ} (xstar η G : ℝ) (hη : 0 ≤ η)
    (hG : ∀ t : ℕ, |g (x t)| ≤ G) (t : ℕ) :
    ‖x t - xstar - η * g (x t)‖ ≤ ‖x t - xstar‖ + η * G
proof:
by
  have hB : ‖g (x t)‖ ≤ G := by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact hG t
  calc
    ‖x t - xstar - η * g (x t)‖ ≤ ‖x t - xstar‖ + ‖η * g (x t)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
    _ = ‖x t - xstar‖ + η * ‖g (x t)‖ := by rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hη]
    _ ≤ ‖x t - xstar‖ + η * G := add_le_add_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hB hη) _

name: fedAvg_rate
doc:
**`fedAvg_rate`（异质性单步界）**：`hsub` 给真实次梯度，`d` 是实际用的方向
    （偏差 ≤ ζ），则单步平方距离满足

    `‖x_{t+1} − x*‖² ≤ ‖x_t − x*‖² − 2η(f x_t − f x*) + 2ηζ‖x_t − x*‖ + η²(G+ζ)²`。
stmt:
theorem fedAvg_rate {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {x : ℕ → ℝ} (d : ℕ → ℝ) (xstar η G ζ : ℝ)
    (hsub : ∀ t : ℕ, Subgradient f (x t) (g (x t)))
    (hη : 0 ≤ η) (_hG0 : 0 ≤ G) (hζ0 : 0 ≤ ζ)
    (hG : ∀ t : ℕ, |g (x t)| ≤ G)
    (hd : ∀ t : ℕ, |d t - g (x t)| ≤ ζ)
    (hstep : ∀ t : ℕ, x (t + 1) = x t - η * d t) (t : ℕ) :
    ‖x (t + 1) - xstar‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖x t - xstar‖ ^ 2 - 2 * η * (f (x t) - f xstar)
      + 2 * η * ζ * ‖x t - xstar‖ + η ^ 2 * (G + ζ) ^ 2
proof:
by
  have hnorm : ‖x (t + 1) - xstar‖ ≤ ‖x t - xstar - η * g (x t)‖ + η * ζ :=
    norm_step_split d xstar η ζ hη hd hstep t
  have hPsq : ‖x t - xstar - η * g (x t)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ‖x t - xstar‖ ^ 2 - 2 * η * (f (x t) - f xstar) + η ^ 2 * G ^ 2 := by
    have h := subgradient_descent_norm_decrease (hsub t) xstar η hη
    simp only [subgradient_descent_step] at h
    have hB : ‖g (x t)‖ ≤ G := by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact hG t
    have hBsq : ‖g (x t)‖ ^ 2 ≤ G ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hB 2
    have h2 : η ^ 2 * ‖g (x t)‖ ^ 2 ≤ η ^ 2 * G ^ 2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hBsq (sq_nonneg η)
    have hsame : ‖x t - η * g (x t) - xstar‖ ^ 2 = ‖x t - xstar - η * g (x t)‖ ^ 2 := by
      ring_nf
    rw [hsame] at h
    linarith [h, h2]
  have hPbound : ‖x t - xstar - η * g (x t)‖ ≤ ‖x t - xstar‖ + η * G :=
    norm_grad_split xstar η G hη hG t
  have hsq : ‖x (t + 1) - xstar‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (‖x t - xstar - η * g (x t)‖ + η * ζ) ^ 2 :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hnorm 2
  have hcross : 2 * (η * ζ) * ‖x t - xstar - η * g (x t)‖ ≤
      2 * (η * ζ) * (‖x t - xstar‖ + η * G) := by
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hPbound
    nlinarith [hη, hζ0]
  have hexp : (‖x t - xstar - η * g (x t)‖ + η * ζ) ^ 2
      = ‖x t - xstar - η * g (x t)‖ ^ 2 + 2 * (η * ζ) * ‖x t - xstar - η * g (x t)‖
        + (η * ζ) ^ 2 := by ring
  have hbridge : (‖x t - xstar‖ ^ 2 - 2 * η * (f (x t) - f xstar) + η ^ 2 * G ^ 2)
        + 2 * (η * ζ) * (‖x t - xstar‖ + η * G) +

name: fedAvg_drift_step
doc: 单步范数漂移（异质性代价）：`‖x_{t+1} − x*‖ ≤ ‖x_t − x*‖ + η(G+ζ)`。
stmt:
theorem fedAvg_drift_step {g : ℝ → ℝ} {x : ℕ → ℝ} (d : ℕ → ℝ) (xstar η G ζ : ℝ)
    (hη : 0 ≤ η) (_hG0 : 0 ≤ G) (_hζ0 : 0 ≤ ζ)
    (hG : ∀ t : ℕ, |g (x t)| ≤ G)
    (hd : ∀ t : ℕ, |d t - g (x t)| ≤ ζ)
    (hstep : ∀ t : ℕ, x (t + 1) = x t - η * d t) (t : ℕ) :
    ‖x (t + 1) - xstar‖ ≤ ‖x t - xstar‖ + η * (G + ζ)
proof:
by
  have h1 := norm_step_split d xstar η ζ hη hd hstep t
  have h2 := norm_grad_split xstar η G hη hG t
  linarith

name: fedAvg_drift_linear
doc:
**累积漂移界**：单步漂移 `‖x_{t+1} − x*‖ ≤ ‖x_t − x*‖ + η(G+ζ)` ⟹
    `‖x_T − x*‖ ≤ ‖x_0 − x*‖ + T·η·(G+ζ)` —— 异质性使距离线性漂移。
stmt:
theorem fedAvg_drift_linear {x : ℕ → ℝ} (xstar η G ζ : ℝ)
    (hinc : ∀ t : ℕ, ‖x (t + 1) - xstar‖ ≤ ‖x t - xstar‖ + η * (G + ζ)) :
    ∀ T : ℕ, ‖x T - xstar‖ ≤ ‖x 0 - xstar‖ + (T : ℝ) * η * (G + ζ)
proof:
by
  intro T
  induction T with
  | zero => simp
  | succ T ih =>
      calc
        ‖x (T + 1) - xstar‖ ≤ ‖x T - xstar‖ + η * (G + ζ) := hinc T
        _ ≤ (‖x 0 - xstar‖ + (T : ℝ) * η * (G + ζ)) + η * (G + ζ) := by linarith
        _ = ‖x 0 - xstar‖ + ((T : ℝ) + 1) * η * (G + ζ) := by ring
        _ = ‖x 0 - xstar‖ + ((T + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * η * (G + ζ) := by
              rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]

             
                                        
                                                 
                                                                            
                                  
                                                
                                                          

end Lattice

name: k01_op_error_of_disturbance
doc:
**`k01_op_error_of_disturbance`（核心桥）**：若 `f` 满足
`dist (f x) (f y) ≤ κ * dist x y`（`κ ≥ 0`），则对任意扰动输入 `x'`（`dist x' x ≤ δ`）有
`dist (f x') (f x) ≤ κ * δ`。

这是 `RealFloatFormat.op_error_propagation`（`:164`）的**载体无关形式**：
把"输入经舍入"读作"输入被扰动 `δ`"，`κ` 保持自由 —— 于是常数族的紧常数可逐字代入。
陈述在任意伪度量空间上，故不预设任何范数/内积结构。
stmt:
theorem k01_op_error_of_disturbance {α : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace α]
    (f : α → α) (κ δ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ)
    (hf : ∀ x y : α, dist (f x) (f y) ≤ κ * dist x y)
    {x x' : α} (hδ : dist x' x ≤ δ) :
    dist (f x') (f x) ≤ κ * δ
proof:
by
  calc dist (f x') (f x) ≤ κ * dist x' x := hf x' x
    _ ≤ κ * δ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hδ hκ

name: k01_rmsNorm_lipschitz_dist
doc:
**`k01_rmsNorm_lipschitz_dist`**：RMSNorm 在 `{‖·‖ ≥ c}` 上是 `(√n/c)`-Lipschitz
的**距离形式**（`dist` 版本），载体与 B 端**逐字一致**，供核心桥消费。
由 `RealRMSNormSharpness.rmsNormE_sqrt_lipschitz`（`:94`）+ `dist_eq_norm` 直接得到。
stmt:
theorem k01_rmsNorm_lipschitz_dist {n : ℕ} (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (c : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hx : c ≤ ‖x‖) (hy : c ≤ ‖y‖) :
    dist (rmsNormE x) (rmsNormE y) ≤ (Real.sqrt n / c) * dist x y
proof:
by
  rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
  exact rmsNormE_sqrt_lipschitz x y c hc hx hy

name: k01_rmsNorm_float_error_bound
doc:
**`k01_rmsNorm_float_error_bound`（K-01 目标）**：设浮点格式 `F`，`c > 0`，
`x` 与扰动点 `x'` 均满足 `c ≤ ‖·‖`，且扰动尺度
`dist x' x ≤ F.eps * ‖x‖ + F.tiny`（这就是 `RoundOp.err_bound` 的形状，
只是把标量 `|x|` 换成同一载体上的 `‖x‖`）。则

    dist (RMSNorm x') (RMSNorm x) ≤ (√n/c) * (F.eps * ‖x‖ + F.tiny)

即 **误差放大 = 紧 Lipschitz 常数 × 单位舍入**。这是 K-01 的 C 端结论：
`κ` 由 B 端的**紧**常数 `√n/c` 填入（而非自由），扰动由 A 端的舍入形状给出。
stmt:
theorem k01_rmsNorm_float_error_bound (F : FloatFormat) {n : ℕ}
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (x x' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hx : c ≤ ‖x‖) (hx' : c ≤ ‖x'‖)
    (hδ : dist x' x ≤ F.eps * ‖x‖ + F.tiny) :
    dist (rmsNormE x') (rmsNormE x) ≤ (Real.sqrt n / c) * (F.eps * ‖x‖ + F.tiny)
proof:
by
  have hκ : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt n / c := div_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg n) (le_of_lt hc)
  calc dist (rmsNormE x') (rmsNormE x)
      ≤ (Real.sqrt n / c) * dist x' x := k01_rmsNorm_lipschitz_dist x' x c hc hx' hx
    _ ≤ (Real.sqrt n / c) * (F.eps * ‖x‖ + F.tiny) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hδ hκ

name: k01_rmsNorm_constant_not_improvable
doc:
**`k01_rmsNorm_constant_not_improvable`（判据 T2）**：`n > 0`、`c > 0` 时，
任何有效的 Lipschitz 常数 `K`（即对 `{‖·‖ ≥ c}` 上所有点对成立）必满足 `√n/c ≤ K`。

这把"K-01 的 `κ` 恰好是 `√n/c`"从事后观察变成**可证事实**：
`κ` **不可能更小**，故 K-01 的常数是**紧的**而非松弛的。
stmt:
theorem k01_rmsNorm_constant_not_improvable {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (c K : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 < c)
    (hK : ∀ x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), c ≤ ‖x‖ → c ≤ ‖y‖ →
      ‖rmsNormE x - rmsNormE y‖ ≤ K * ‖x - y‖) :
    Real.sqrt n / c ≤ K
proof: (rmsNormE_constant_iff hn c K hc).mp hK

name: k01_relaxed_constant_also_connects
doc:
**`k01_relaxed_constant_also_connects`（负对照 NC-3）**：把 K-01 的常数从紧的
`√n/c` 换成松弛的 `2√n/c`，**结论照样成立**（因为松弛界也是有效 Lipschitz 界）。

注意 **这正是阴性说明**（`三期22-B` §4.2 NC-3）：**光有"能接"不足以证明接得对** ——
只有配上 §四 的唯一性才是真正的判据。本文件保留该负对照，以免读者把
"K-01 能接上"误读为"K-01 的常数是紧的"。
stmt:
theorem k01_relaxed_constant_also_connects (F : FloatFormat) {n : ℕ}
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (x x' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hx : c ≤ ‖x‖) (hx' : c ≤ ‖x'‖)
    (hδ : dist x' x ≤ F.eps * ‖x‖ + F.tiny) :
    dist (rmsNormE x') (rmsNormE x) ≤ (2 * Real.sqrt n / c) * (F.eps * ‖x‖ + F.tiny)
proof:
by
                                                                
                                                          
                                                               
                                                                
  have hle : Real.sqrt n / c ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt n / c := by
    have hs : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt n := Real.sqrt_nonneg n
    have h3 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt n / c := div_nonneg hs (le_of_lt hc)
    have h2 : 2 * Real.sqrt n / c - Real.sqrt n / c = Real.sqrt n / c := by ring
    linarith
  calc dist (rmsNormE x') (rmsNormE x)
      ≤ (Real.sqrt n / c) * (F.eps * ‖x‖ + F.tiny) :=
        k01_rmsNorm_float_error_bound F c hc x x' hx hx' hδ
    _ ≤ (2 * Real.sqrt n / c) * (F.eps * ‖x‖ + F.tiny) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hle
          (add_nonneg (mul_nonneg F.eps_nonneg (norm_nonneg x)) F.tiny_nonneg)

end Lattice

name: glu_lipschitz
doc:
**GLU 的 Lipschitz 常数**：`SoftMasked act s`、`|s| ≤ 1`、门 `s∘a` 是 `Lg`-Lipschitz、
信号 `a·b` 是 `Lh`-Lipschitz 且 `|a·b| ≤ M` ⟹ GLU 块是 `(Lh + M·Lg)`-Lipschitz。
直接套 `gated_lipschitz` 与 `glu_is_gated`。
stmt:
theorem glu_lipschitz {act s : ℝ → ℝ} (hsm : SoftMasked act s) (hs : ∀ y, |s y| ≤ 1)
    {a b : ℝ → ℝ} {Lg Lh M : ℝ} (hLg : 0 ≤ Lg)
    (hgL : ∀ x y, |s (a x) - s (a y)| ≤ Lg * |x - y|)
    (hhL : ∀ x y, |a x * b x - a y * b y| ≤ Lh * |x - y|)
    (hhM : ∀ x, |a x * b x| ≤ M) (x y : ℝ) :
    |glu act a b x - glu act a b y| ≤ (Lh + M * Lg) * |x - y|
proof:
gated_lipschitz (glu act a b) (fun z => s (a z)) (fun z => a z * b z) Lg Lh M
    (glu_is_gated hsm a b) (fun z => hs (a z)) hgL hhL hhM hLg x y

name: reglu_lipschitz
doc: **ReGLU 的 Lipschitz 常数**（`act = relu`，掩码 `reluSoftMask ∈ {0,1}`）。
stmt:
theorem reglu_lipschitz {a b : ℝ → ℝ} {Lg Lh M : ℝ} (hLg : 0 ≤ Lg)
    (hgL : ∀ x y, |reluSoftMask (a x) - reluSoftMask (a y)| ≤ Lg * |x - y|)
    (hhL : ∀ x y, |a x * b x - a y * b y| ≤ Lh * |x - y|)
    (hhM : ∀ x, |a x * b x| ≤ M) (x y : ℝ) :
    |reglu a b x - reglu a b y| ≤ (Lh + M * Lg) * |x - y|
proof: glu_lipschitz relu_is_soft_masked reluSoftMask_abs_le_one hLg hgL hhL hhM x y

name: siluGLU_lipschitz
doc: **SiLU-GLU 的 Lipschitz 常数**（`act = silu`，掩码 `sigmoid ∈ [0,1]`）。
stmt:
theorem siluGLU_lipschitz {a b : ℝ → ℝ} {Lg Lh M : ℝ} (hLg : 0 ≤ Lg)
    (hgL : ∀ x y, |sigmoid (a x) - sigmoid (a y)| ≤ Lg * |x - y|)
    (hhL : ∀ x y, |a x * b x - a y * b y| ≤ Lh * |x - y|)
    (hhM : ∀ x, |a x * b x| ≤ M) (x y : ℝ) :
    |siluGLU a b x - siluGLU a b y| ≤ (Lh + M * Lg) * |x - y|
proof: glu_lipschitz silu_is_soft_masked sigmoid_abs_le_one hLg hgL hhL hhM x y

name: geglu_lipschitz
doc: **GeGLU 的 Lipschitz 常数**（`act = geluTanh`，掩码 `geluSoftMask ∈ [0,1]`）。
stmt:
theorem geglu_lipschitz {a b : ℝ → ℝ} {Lg Lh M : ℝ} (hLg : 0 ≤ Lg)
    (hgL : ∀ x y, |geluSoftMask (a x) - geluSoftMask (a y)| ≤ Lg * |x - y|)

name: gd_descent_of_smooth
doc:
**由 `C`-光滑下降引理得单步下降**：若
`L(w − η g w) ≤ L w − η(g w)² + (η²C/2)(g w)²`、`η ≥ 0`、`η·C ≤ 1`，则
`L(w_{next}) ≤ L w − (η/2)(g w)²`。
（**光滑性假设显式外置**，见 docstring。）
stmt:
theorem gd_descent_of_smooth {loss g : ℝ → ℝ} {eta C : ℝ}
    (hdesc : ∀ w, loss (gdStep g eta w)
      ≤ loss w - eta * (g w) ^ 2 + (eta ^ 2 * C / 2) * (g w) ^ 2)
    (heta : 0 ≤ eta) (hC : eta * C ≤ 1) (w : ℝ) :
    loss (gdStep g eta w) ≤ loss w - (eta / 2) * (g w) ^ 2
proof:
by
  have h := hdesc w
  have h1 : eta * (eta * C) ≤ eta * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hC heta
  nlinarith [h, h1, sq_nonneg (g w), sq_nonneg (eta * g w)]

name: gd_telescope
doc:
**误差递推（望远镜求和）**：由单步下降
`L(w_{t+1}) ≤ L(w_t) − (η/2)(g w_t)²` 得
`L(w_n) + (η/2)·Σ_{k<n}(g w_k)² ≤ L(w_0)`。
stmt:
theorem gd_telescope {loss g : ℝ → ℝ} {eta w0 : ℝ}
    (hdesc : ∀ w, loss (gdStep g eta w) ≤ loss w - (eta / 2) * (g w) ^ 2) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, loss (gdSeq g eta w0 n)
        + (eta / 2) * ∑ k in Finset.range n, (g (gdSeq g eta w0 k)) ^ 2
      ≤ loss (gdSeq g eta w0 0)
proof:
by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      have hstep := hdesc (gdSeq g eta w0 n)
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, gdSeq_succ]
      rw [mul_add]
      linarith

name: gd_exists_small_gradient
doc:
**ε-终止**：若损失有下界 `Lstar ≤ L(w_n)`（∀n）、`η > 0`、`ε > 0`，
则存在 `n` 使 `(g w_n)² ≤ ε`（反证 + 望远镜 + 阿基米德）。
stmt:
theorem gd_exists_small_gradient {loss g : ℝ → ℝ} {eta Lstar w0 eps : ℝ}
    (hdesc : ∀ w, loss (gdStep g eta w) ≤ loss w - (eta / 2) * (g w) ^ 2)
    (heta : 0 < eta) (hbdd : ∀ n, Lstar ≤ loss (gdSeq g eta w0 n))
    (heps : 0 < eps) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, (g (gdSeq g eta w0 n)) ^ 2 ≤ eps
proof:
by
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  set D : ℝ := loss (gdSeq g eta w0 0) - Lstar with hD
  have hcpos : 0 < (eta / 2) * eps := by positivity
  have hkey : ∀ n : ℕ, (n : ℝ) * ((eta / 2) * eps) ≤ D := by
    intro n
    have htel := gd_telescope (w0 := w0) hdesc n
    have hb := hbdd n
    have hsum : (n : ℝ) * eps ≤ ∑ k in Finset.range n, (g (gdSeq g eta w0 k)) ^ 2 := by
      have h2 : ∑ _k in Finset.range n, eps
          ≤ ∑ k in Finset.range n, (g (gdSeq g eta w0 k)) ^ 2 :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun k _ => le_of_lt (hcon k))
      simpa [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul] using h2
    have h3 : (eta / 2) * ((n : ℝ) * eps)
        ≤ (eta / 2) * ∑ k in Finset.range n, (g (gdSeq g eta w0 k)) ^ 2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum (by positivity)
    have : (eta / 2) * ((n : ℝ) * eps) ≤ D := by
      rw [hD]
      linarith
    calc (n : ℝ) * ((eta / 2) * eps) = (eta / 2) * ((n : ℝ) * eps) := by ring
      _ ≤ D := this
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt (D / ((eta / 2) * eps))
  have hN' : D < (N : ℝ) * ((eta / 2) * eps) := (div_lt_iff₀ hcpos).mp hN
  linarith [hkey N]

name: gd_epsilon_termination
doc: **ε-终止（包装形式）**：存在长度 `N` 的前缀，其中某一步的梯度平方 `≤ ε`。
stmt:
theorem gd_epsilon_termination {loss g : ℝ → ℝ} {eta Lstar w0 eps : ℝ}
    (hdesc : ∀ w, loss (gdStep g eta w) ≤ loss w - (eta / 2) * (g w) ^ 2)
    (heta : 0 < eta) (hbdd : ∀ n, Lstar ≤ loss (gdSeq g eta w0 n))
    (heps : 0 < eps) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∃ n ≤ N, (g (gdSeq g eta w0 n)) ^ 2 ≤ eps
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := gd_exists_small_gradient (w0 := w0) hdesc heta hbdd heps
  exact ⟨n, n, le_rfl, hn⟩

name: euler_step_loss_bound
doc:
**欧拉步的损失上界**：下降引理 + 梯度步 `y = x - η·∇L(x)` ⟹

  `L(x - η g) ≤ L(x) - η(1 - ηL/2)·‖g‖²`，其中 `g = ∇L(x)`。

**它比定义多说了什么**：把下降引理中的 `⟨g, y-x⟩ + (L/2)‖y-x‖²` 在
`y - x = -η g` 处**解出来**，得到纯 `‖g‖²` 的表达式。
这是全部步长条件的来源：下降量非负 ⟺ `1 - ηL/2 ≥ 0` ⟺ `η ≤ 2/L`。

**证明**：`⟨g, -ηg⟩ = -η‖g‖²`（实内积），`‖-ηg‖² = η²‖g‖²`。
stmt:
theorem euler_step_loss_bound {L : ℝ} {f : E → ℝ} {grad : E → E} (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hdesc : descentLemmaHolds L f grad) (x : E) (η : ℝ) :
    f (x - η • grad x) ≤ f x - η * (1 - η * L / 2) * ‖grad x‖ ^ 2
proof:
by
  have h := hdesc x (x - η • grad x)
  have hsub : x - η • grad x - x = -(η • grad x) := by abel
  rw [hsub] at h
  have hinner : inner (grad x) (-(η • grad x)) = -η * ‖grad x‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [inner_neg_right, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    ring
  have hnorm : ‖-(η • grad x)‖ ^ 2 = η ^ 2 * ‖grad x‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [norm_neg, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs]
  rw [hinner, hnorm] at h
  linarith [h]

name: euler_descent
doc:
**稳定性条件（非严格版）：`0 < η ≤ 2/L` ⟹ 损失不升**。

**它比定义多说了什么**：把「步长不能太大」这一直觉化为**显式的阈值 `2/L`**，
并给出**可代入的下降量**。`η = 2/L`（**取等号处**）时下降量为 `0`，
故结论只能是 `≤`（**非严格**）。

⚠ **阈值不可放宽**：`η > 2/L` 时损失可能**上升**（见 `euler_divergence_witness`）。
`L > 0` 不可省（`2/L` 的分母）。
stmt:
theorem euler_descent {L : ℝ} {f : E → ℝ} {grad : E → E} (hL : 0 < L)
    (hdesc : descentLemmaHolds L f grad) (x : E) (η : ℝ) (hη0 : 0 < η) (hη : η ≤ 2 / L) :
    f (x - η • grad x) ≤ f x
proof:
by
  have hb := euler_step_loss_bound (le_of_lt hL) hdesc x η
  have hLc : (2 / L) * L = 2 := by
    rw [div_mul_cancel₀]
    exact ne_of_gt hL
  have hcoef : 0 ≤ η * (1 - η * L / 2) := by
    have h1 : η * L / 2 ≤ 1 := by
      have h2 : η * L ≤ 2 :=
        le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hη (le_of_lt hL)) (le_of_eq hLc)
      linarith
    nlinarith [hη0, h1]
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ η * (1 - η * L / 2) * ‖grad x‖ ^ 2 :=
    mul_nonneg hcoef (sq_nonneg _)
  linarith [hb, hnonneg]

name: euler_strict_descent
doc:
**稳定性条件（严格版）：`0 < η < 2/L` 且 `∇L(x) ≠ 0` ⟹ 损失严格下降**。

**它比定义多说了什么**：把 `η = 2/L` 这一**取等边界**排除后，
下降量**严格为正**：`η(1 - ηL/2)·‖g‖² > 0`（三因子皆正）。
⚠ **`∇L(x) ≠ 0` 不可省**：驻点处（`g = 0`）任何步长都不产生下降，
断言「严格下降」是**假命题**（反例：`f ≡ 0`，`grad ≡ 0`，任意 `η`）。
stmt:
theorem euler_strict_descent {L : ℝ} {f : E → ℝ} {grad : E → E} (hL : 0 < L)
    (hdesc : descentLemmaHolds L f grad) (x : E) (η : ℝ) (hη0 : 0 < η) (hη : η < 2 / L)
    (hg : grad x ≠ 0) :
    f (x - η • grad x) < f x
proof:
by
  have hb := euler_step_loss_bound (le_of_lt hL) hdesc x η
  have hLc : (2 / L) * L = 2 := by
    rw [div_mul_cancel₀]
    exact ne_of_gt hL
  have h1 : η * L / 2 < 1 := by
    have h2 : η * L < 2 :=
      lt_of_lt_of_eq (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hη hL) hLc
    linarith
  have hcoef : 0 < η * (1 - η * L / 2) := mul_pos hη0 (by linarith)
  have hgnorm : 0 < ‖grad x‖ ^ 2 := by
    rcases eq_or_ne ‖grad x‖ 0 with h | h
    · exact absurd (norm_eq_zero.mp h) hg
    · positivity
  have hpos : 0 < η * (1 - η * L / 2) * ‖grad x‖ ^ 2 := mul_pos hcoef hgnorm
  linarith [hb, hpos]

name: euler_divergence_witness
doc:
**发散见证（`η > 2/L` 时损失可以上升）**。

`E = ℝ`、`f x = (L/2)x²`（`∇f = L·x`，`L`-光滑）、`x = 1`、`η > 2/L` 时：
`f(x - η∇f(x)) = (L/2)(1 - ηL)² > (L/2) = f(x)`。

**它比定义多说了什么**：**证明** `η ≤ 2/L` 这个阈值**不是**技术性保守
（即「去掉上界假设后定理为假」的**机器验证反例背书**）。
⚠ 注意本定理的**结论方向**：它给出**存在**一个函数使损失上升，
**不**断言「所有函数都上升」——后者是**假**的（见「诚实边界」）。
stmt:
theorem euler_divergence_witness (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (η : ℝ) (hη : 2 / L < η) :
    (L / 2) * (1 : ℝ) ^ 2 < (L / 2) * (1 - η * L) ^ 2
proof:
by
  have hηL : 2 < η * L := by
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ hL] at hη
    linarith
  have h1 : (1 : ℝ) - η * L < -1 := by linarith
  have h2 : 1 < (1 - η * L) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [h1]
  nlinarith [hL, h2]

end Lattice

name: richardson_error
doc: 误差恒等式：A xs = b ⟹ richerdson(A,b,ω,x) − xs = (1 − ωA)(x − xs)。
stmt:
theorem richardson_error (A : E →L[ℝ] E) (b xs x : E) (ω : ℝ) (hxs : A xs = b) :
    richardson A b ω x - xs = (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E - ω • A) (x - xs)
proof:
by
  have h1 : richardson A b ω x - xs = x - xs - ω • (A x - b) := by
    unfold richardson
    abel
  have h2 : (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E - ω • A) (x - xs) = x - xs - ω • (A x - b) := by
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      map_sub, hxs]
  rw [h1, h2]

name: richardson_contraction
doc: 收缩定理：‖1 − ωA‖ ≤ c ⟹ ‖richardson − xs‖ ≤ c·‖x − xs‖。
stmt:
theorem richardson_contraction (A : E →L[ℝ] E) (b xs x : E) (ω c : ℝ)
    (hxs : A xs = b) (hc : ‖ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E - ω • A‖ ≤ c) :
    ‖richardson A b ω x - xs‖ ≤ c * ‖x - xs‖
proof:
by
  rw [richardson_error A b xs x ω hxs]
  calc
    ‖(ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E - ω • A) (x - xs)‖ ≤
        ‖ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E - ω • A‖ * ‖x - xs‖ :=
      (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E - ω • A).le_opNorm _
    _ ≤ c * ‖x - xs‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc (norm_nonneg _)
